entries.title: Biggest climbs: five ladders or five rows

values.label: default: five ladders, one per race, each as long as its classified field; his marker rises from grid slot to finish
five rows: the field as a line of grid slots, front on the right; his marker runs forward

entries.look: Open More from the archive → Biggest climbs and watch the five markers rise once; hover (or tap on the phone) a climb to read it, click (or tap again) to open the race.
